_comment: One shop = one file. Copy this, change the persona and price list, and run with SHOP_CONFIG=shops/your_shop.json. Prices and floors stay in deterministic code; the LLM never sets a price. 'keywords' are optional words the offline (no-LLM) parser uses to pick a product.
